description: This file contains utility functions for LAN management in a network device, including parsing IPv6 addresses, MAC address derivation from IPv6, and a parameter change callback for DHCP-related parameters.

methods.name: LanManager_ParamValueChanged
methods.description: Callback function to handle parameter value changes related to DHCP server pools, triggering host polling on relevant changes.

methods.name: LanManager_GetMACAddrFromIPv6Addr
methods.description: Derives a MAC address from a given IPv6 address according to RFC 4291, or returns the interface ID if derivation is not possible.

methods.name: LanManager_GetMACAddrFromIPv6LinkLocalAddr
methods.description: Derives a MAC address from a link-local IPv6 address following RFC 4291, or returns the interface ID if not a link-local address.

methods.name: void LanManager_CheckCloneCopy(char ** dest,const char * src)
methods.description: Safely clones or copies a string to ensure proper memory management.
